summary: Specifies how Multicast VPN (MVPN) can use Bit Index Explicit Replication (BIER) to carry multicast traffic across a provider backbone. BIER provides efficient multicast forwarding through a domain without intermediate routers keeping per-flow state. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Sending the same video to many viewers can burden the routers in between. BIER stamps each packet with a list of who needs it, so the routers just copy it to the right places without remembering each show.
